verdict.rationale: Column documents Custom Roles with granular access to specific bank accounts and transfer types, and API keys scoped to sandbox or live mode. These are general access controls, not an agent-operation capability: the pack does not tie roles to API credentials or mention agents at all. Nothing documents per-credential amount caps or counterparty allowlists, and the community note on ACH account-number limits is about a different feature, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can operate an account within policy — scoped credentials that let it read balances and initiate transfers under amount caps and counterparty allowlists, a use the vendor documents by name
